status: source frozen; WSL specialized11/0 and basis11/0 process0; standalone startup/normal exit0; unified integration pending
existing_schema: sn100-catalog-offline-v1 marker and original tables/columns remain compatible
tables: reagent_batch_metadata(batch_id PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES reagent_batch_group(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, isi_value TEXT NOT NULL, normal_value TEXT NOT NULL)
catalog_batch_reference(owner_module TEXT, reference_key TEXT, batch_id REFERENCES reagent_batch_group(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY(owner_module,reference_key))
project_action_reagent_reference(project_id REFERENCES project_base(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, reagent_id REFERENCES reagent_list(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY(project_id,reagent_id))

fields.id: stable reagent_batch_group.id; not row number, display code or instrument ID
fields.code: existing local batch_code, 1..32 chars without outer whitespace
fields.batchGroup: existing | separated reagent batch numbers, nonempty members <=32 chars, no duplicate members, no membership overlap within a project
fields.isiValue: original isi_value.isiValue decimal text, dimensionless ISI; 0..9999 max4 decimal places, not a calculation/approval
fields.normalValue: original isi_value.normalValue decimal text; source PT measured-result unit must be supplied with approved production configuration; no conversion or inferred clinical value
fields.hasMetadata: read snapshot indicates stored metadata exists
fields.metadataEdited: explicit write intent false by default, old four-field saveBatch callers preserve metadata

reading: ReagentStore::load -> loaded(ReagentSnapshot): committed transaction snapshot containing batches and metadata; no QWidget SQL; Consumers must persist values/units used in their own result record; changing current metadata must never recalculate or rewrite saved historical result values.
reservation_protocol: Reserve stable project and batch IDs in catalog before external record write; owner module lowercase [a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}, key 1..128 chars without outer whitespace.
Same module/key/batch reserve is idempotent; binding an existing key to a different batch fails.
Save external record in its own database; after failure explicitly reconcile/release only if no external record depends on it. No cross-file foreign key or atomic transaction claimed.
External deletion commits first, then release reservation. Crashes may leak safe blocking holds; startup never clears them automatically.
While held, batch code/group/project changes fail and deletion is FK restricted; metadata edits remain local editable information.
Reserve project separately whenever external records depend on project name; holdBatchReference alone does not protect project display name.
Project-action reagent references are maintained by ProjectsStore; ReagentStore rejects name/type changes and deletion until those references are removed.
deliberate_differences: Store original ISI/normalValue by stable batch ID rather than unqualified batch_group string, avoiding cross-project string collisions.
Both declared numeric bounds and max4 decimal precision enforced at storage boundary; original getExpStr uses digit count and can accept >9999 fractional text.
Batch reference reservation is conservative additive local protection; no external schema guessed or opened.

Original .ui retained unchanged; original PT-prefix field visibility retained. Calculation/edit icon actions and enabling runtime batch management remain disabled pending required implementation/production protocol.
Local batch save also commits edited metadata in one catalog transaction; old saveBatch callers leave metadata untouched.
not_claimed: Clinical calculation, calibration audit/apply effectiveness, real test actions, instrument/LIS/RK connections
Original active Windows visual/behavior parity, ARM64/Windows whole-program build
